name: Soft Hours Body Wash
description: A low-foam body cleanser with a soft, clean scent that stays close to the skin.
fullDescription:
Soft Hours is a gentle daily body wash designed to cleanse without leaving skin feeling tight or overly fragranced.

The scent opens with bergamot and white tea before settling into creamy rice milk and sandalwood.

Its lightweight gel texture creates a soft lather and rinses clean, leaving only a subtle trace of fragrance behind.
use: Massage onto wet skin, work into a gentle lather, and rinse thoroughly.

name: Soft Hours Body Lotion
description: A lightweight daily lotion scented with white tea, rice milk, and sandalwood.
fullDescription:
Made for the minutes after a shower.

Soft Hours Body Lotion absorbs quickly and leaves skin feeling comfortable rather than coated.

White tea and bergamot give way to creamy rice milk and sandalwood for a subtle fragrance that layers naturally with the rest of the Soft Hours collection.
use: Massage into clean skin, concentrating on dry areas.

name: Still Water Body Oil
description: A dry-touch body oil with neroli, mineral woods, and skin musk.
fullDescription:
Still Water gives skin a soft sheen without the heavy finish of a traditional body oil.

A blend of lightweight plant oils absorbs quickly while neroli, mineral woods, and musk leave a barely-there scent.

Use it alone or layered underneath fragrance.

name: Sunday Skin Hand Wash
description: A gentle hand cleanser scented with fig leaf, black tea, and pale woods.
fullDescription:
Sunday Skin turns something ordinary into a small ritual.

The gentle cleanser leaves hands clean without feeling stripped, while fig leaf and black tea settle into pale cedar and musk.

name: Sunday Skin Hand Cream
description: A fast-absorbing hand cream with fig leaf, black tea, cedar, and soft musk.
fullDescription: A fast-absorbing hand cream with fig leaf, black tea, cedar, and soft musk.

name: After Rain Eau De Parfum
description: The smell of pavement after summer rain, softened by iris and warm skin.
fullDescription:
After Rain begins cool and mineral before becoming increasingly intimate on skin.

Bergamot and a translucent rain accord create the first impression. Iris and violet leaf soften the center while wet cedar, ambrette, and white musk form a warm, understated base.

name: Quiet Morning Eau De Parfum
description: Clean sheets, open curtains, and the first cup of tea.
fullDescription:
Quiet Morning is a clean fragrance without the sharpness traditionally associated with fresh scents.

Pear skin and bergamot open softly before white tea and orris emerge. Cashmere wood and musk create a warm finish that sits close to the body.

name: No. 03 Late Light Eau De Parfum
description: Golden-hour warmth translated into fig, tea, cedar, and amber.
fullDescription:
Late Light is inspired by the final warm light that enters a room before evening.

Mandarin and pink pepper provide brightness before giving way to ripe fig and black tea. Cedar, tonka, and amber create a warm drydown.

name: Open Window Candle
description: The scent of cool air moving through a room after rain.
fullDescription:
Open Window combines mineral rain notes with eucalyptus, cedar, and white musk.

Designed to freshen a room without overwhelming it.
use:
Trim wick to approximately 5 mm before each burn.

Never burn longer than four hours at a time.
